result.title: LeJEPA Features Are Not Isotropic, and Should Not Be
result.summary: The SIGReg term in LeJEPA regularizes features to have an isotropic Gaussian distribution. Our first result is to show that this regularizer, in practice, cannot achieve its goal. We design a modified regularizer to enforce the objective better. This leads to slightly improved performance. For example, on ImageNet-100, our modified regularizer reaches the final accuracy of SIGReg in 1.3$\times$ fewer epochs. Our second result argues that self-supervised encoders should not have isotropic Gaussian features. We show that the alignment term in LeJEPA conflicts with SIGReg, because it couples the magnitude of the features with their directions. In contrast, isotropic Gaussian features would entail independent magnitude and directions. Features obtained with LeJEPA are, in fact, not isotropic. So LeJEPA has two issues. Its regularizer is weak, and the isotropic Gaussian target is too strict. Our third result is about reformulating the isotropic Gaussian regularizer to enforce only the marginal distributions of the magnitude and direction, without enforcing independence. This leads to a simple regularization term, PolarReg, that can be optimized reliably across many different datasets, batch sizes and embedding dimensions without any hyper-parameter changes. On ImageNet-1k, our technique matches the accuracy of LeJEPA and its variants in 4.7$\times$ fewer epochs. It improves the final accuracy by 1.8 points.

AI.brief_summary: 论文分析 LeJEPA 中 SIGReg 各向同性高斯正则难以在实际中达成且目标过严，指出对齐项使特征模长与方向耦合，进而提出仅约束模长与方向边缘分布的 PolarReg，在多个数据集和嵌入维度上免调超参并加快收敛、提升精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽为纯自监督视觉表征正则工作，但其对特征分布几何、模长与方向是否解耦及正则强度的分析，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态几何约束、表示坍缩与训练监督设计时借鉴，是否能迁移到多模态推理尚未验证。
